rows.comment: Tokyo Sonata” enthrals audiences for the first hour with the pacing of a thriller.
rows.verdict_le10: Tokyo Sonata” enthrals audiences for the first hour with the pacing of a thriller.
rows.dek_lead: Festival invitations can be taken for granted. Thanks to the script which invests the smallest scenes with dramatic significance, “Tokyo Sonata” enthrals audiences for the first hour with the pacing of a thriller.
